correction.valid: The previously reported greedy A, B, M and tau stage counts were exact minima in all 768 truth cases.
correction.correction_needed: The earlier sequential A+B total was an upper-bound construction, not automatically the joint minimum. Exact joint A+B optimization gives a different distribution but the same maximum bound of 3 nodes.
correction.consequence: Claims that at most 3 direct A+B nodes and at most 2 direct-M nodes suffice in the frozen v3 universe remain valid and are now exact existence bounds.
